title: GREAT LAKES ICE COVERAGE
source_name: U.S. National Ice Center (NAIS) daily Great Lakes ice analysis, GRID 1800
zero_ice_rendering: fully transparent (open water shows no overlay)
note: An all-zero (ice-free) grid in the warm season is VALID data, not corruption. Corruption is detected via file structure, grid dimensions, value domain, and water-cell fraction checks.
